class.name: RenderingUpscaleParameters
class.brief_description: Inputs and outputs of a custom upscaler for one view.
class.description: Passed to [method RenderingUpscaler._upscale] and [method RenderingUpscaler._record_native_commands]. The texture [RID]s belong to the renderer and are only valid during these calls.

method.name: get_camera_transform
method.description: Returns the camera transform of the current frame.

method.name: get_color
method.description: Returns the HDR scene color at the internal resolution, rendered with a jittered projection.

method.name: get_delta_time
method.description: Returns the time since the previous frame, in seconds.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns the depth buffer at the internal resolution. Godot uses reversed Z: the near plane is [code]1.0[/code] and the far plane is [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: get_exposure
method.description: Returns a 1×1 [code]R32F[/code] texture with the auto exposure luminance, or an invalid [RID] when auto exposure is disabled.

method.name: get_fov_y
method.description: Returns the vertical field of view of the camera, in radians.

method.name: get_frame
method.description: Returns the index of the frame being rendered.

method.name: get_jitter
method.description: Returns the sub-pixel jitter applied to the projection of this frame, in pixels of the internal resolution.

method.name: get_output
method.description: Returns the storage texture that must receive the upscaled image, at the target resolution.

method.name: get_previous_camera_transform
method.description: Returns the camera transform of the previous frame.

method.name: get_previous_projection
method.description: Returns the projection of the previous frame for this view.

method.name: get_projection
method.description: Returns the projection of the current frame for this view.

method.name: get_reactive
method.description: Returns an optional mask at the internal resolution where higher values mark pixels that should rely less on history (for example transparent surfaces), or an invalid [RID].

method.name: get_render_size
method.description: Returns the internal resolution the scene was rendered at.

method.name: get_reprojection
method.description: Returns the matrix that transforms clip space positions of this frame (with Vulkan depth correction) into clip space positions of the previous frame, which can be used to reproject pixels that don't have motion vectors.

method.name: get_reset
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the history must be discarded: on the first frame after the render buffers were (re)created, after the viewport's camera changed, or after [method Viewport.reset_temporal_history] was called.

method.name: get_sharpness
method.description: Returns the sharpness requested with [member Viewport.fsr_sharpness].

method.name: get_target_size
method.description: Returns the output resolution.

method.name: get_velocity
method.description: Returns the motion vectors at the internal resolution. Each pixel stores [code]previous_uv - current_uv[/code] in normalized texture coordinates; multiply by [method get_render_size] to obtain pixels.

method.name: get_view
method.description: Returns the index of the view being upscaled, for multiview (XR) rendering.

method.name: get_view_count
method.description: Returns the number of views rendered this frame.

method.name: get_z_far
method.description: Returns the distance of the far plane of the camera.

method.name: get_z_near
method.description: Returns the distance of the near plane of the camera.
